q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWEE FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) >= 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWEE FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) >= 1
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 does not use DISTINCT when counting followers for each followee, while Q2 uses DISTINCT in the COUNT and GROUP BY clauses. This can lead to different results if a followee has multiple followers with the same name.
